content:
Shopify reported Q1 2026 yesterday. The numbers are loud. Are they really for everyone?

In this issue

  • Read With Me. In Shopify For Everyone! (ACG #44, April 29, 2026) I argued the universal pitch ("Shopify is perfect for you") doesn't fit every merchant.
  • The Numbers. Q1 2026, reported May 5, 2026 (Sources: Shopify Q1 2026 financial results press release; The Motley Fool transcript).
  • What The Numbers Show. The "everything for everyone" pitch I called industry-driven last week shows up in the operating data this week.
  • The Agentic Claim. The numbers behind that claim.
  • Sidekick Becoming A Co-Founder. The numbers behind the quote.
  • The Strategy Question. Shopify is doing everything for a lot of people.
  • Where Shopify Is Just OK. I named six platforms last week. I will not revisit those.
